definitions.gloss: every other ~; at intervals of ~; leaving a gap of ~
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a number-plus-counter phrase to state the size of the gap between one occurrence and the next. Because it names the gap rather than the cycle, {一日|いちにち}おきに means every second day, not every day. Used for gaps in time and in space alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おきに⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the medicine every other day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十五分|じゅうごふん}おきに⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Buses leave this station every fifteen minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧おきに⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植|う}えられている→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: Cherry trees are planted at ten-meter intervals along both sides of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧おきに⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm worried about how my grandmother is doing, so I make a point of phoning every third day.

notes:
From ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place, to leave), so the literal sense is "leaving ~ in between."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おきに: every other day (one day skipped)
- ⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧おきに: every two weeks
- {一行|いちぎょう}おきに: on every other line
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧おきに: every other one
- ⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧おきに: every thirty minutes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: every ~ — counts the unit itself, so ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is every single day, while ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おきに is every second day. With durations such as ⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧, the two come out the same, and speakers often use them interchangeably there.

WATCH OUT:
With counters of two or more, native usage is not fully consistent; ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧おきに is normally every third day, but some speakers say it for every second day. When precision matters, say ⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧ (once every three days) instead.
